summary: The recorded base reproducibly raises AttributeError in the inherited insertion and prefix-match contracts because MlxAuxiliaryStateComponent lacks mamba_max_states_per_path and mamba_checkpoint_grid. The base already contains the mamba_allocator alias, so that reported subproblem predates the candidate and is not candidate work. At the exact candidate commit, an independent model-free harness over the real production module confirmed initialization of the inherited fields, synchronous CoW into an existing request slot, CoW with allocation of a new request slot, and no copy when CoW is disabled. The production change is narrowly consistent with the source contract. However, the candidate's three added tests live behind the file-wide MLX availability guard and all 41 tests skip on this host; they also instantiate the component directly rather than driving the real UnifiedRadixCache insertion/match/eviction paths described by the issue. With no Apple Silicon or MLX runtime, the original first-request serving crash and real-cache regression remain unexecuted, so this review cannot honestly mark the original issue fully resolved.

remaining_counterexamples: A real UnifiedRadixCache on Apple MLX inserting the first completed hybrid-SSM request was not executed, so the reported scheduler-crash path remains runtime-unverified.
A real prefix hit on Apple MLX was not executed, so the copied native auxiliary snapshot's restoration and avoidance of full-prompt recomputation remain runtime-unverified.
Real-cache slot exhaustion/eviction and matched-but-not-admitted scheduler rollback were not exercised end to end with MLX objects.

The candidate regression tests do not construct and drive the real UnifiedRadixCache promised by the original issue's model-free reproduction; on this host they are all skipped by the module-level MLX guard.
remaining_limitations: No Apple Silicon, Metal runtime, mlx package, or hybrid-SSM model weights were available.

The independent harness uses the actual Python production class and Torch index tensors but substitutes a minimal MLX module and snapshot pool; it validates control-flow contracts, not native MLX array semantics or serving.
No native sources changed, so no native rebuild was required or performed.
The assigned AMD GPU was intentionally not used as evidence for an Apple-only backend.
